# Fed For Less

> Fed For Less (fedforless.ca) publishes cheap, filling recipes for Canadians with the price worked out first. Every recipe is costed on Statistics Canada national average retail prices (Table 18-10-0245) and shows the ingredient cost used, the batch cost, the cost per serving from a measured yield, and the basket cost (the till price if you need to buy every package). All prices are CAD before tax and include a typical low to high range. Price tiers: Green up to $1.50 a serving, Butter $1.51 to $2.50 a serving, Tomato $2.51 to $3.25 a serving.

## Key pages

- [How We Price](https://fedforless.ca/how-we-price/): the pricing method, the sources, and how the four cost figures on every recipe are worked out.
- [About Fed For Less](https://fedforless.ca/about/): what the site is and who it is for.
- [All Recipes](https://fedforless.ca/recipes/): the full recipe index.
- [Collections](https://fedforless.ca/collections/): recipes grouped by budget job, including dinners under $1.50 a serving and batches that feed six for under $12.

## Recipes

Prices checked August 2026 against Statistics Canada average retail prices, Canada.

- [Budget Pork and White Bean Chili](https://fedforless.ca/recipes/budget-pork-white-bean-chili/): $2.45 per serving, Butter Tier, serves 6, 55 min total. This budget pork and white bean chili feeds six for about $2.45 a serving. Tender pork shoulder, creamy beans and corn, full cost breakdown inside.

- [Budget Tuna Noodle Casserole with Peas](https://fedforless.ca/recipes/budget-tuna-noodle-casserole/): $1.89 per serving, Butter Tier, serves 6, 45 min total. This budget tuna noodle casserole feeds six for about $1.89 a serving. A quick sauce from scratch, sweet peas and a cheesy top, full cost breakdown inside.

- [Cheap Baked Oatmeal with Apple and Peanut Butter](https://fedforless.ca/recipes/cheap-baked-oatmeal/): $0.94 per serving, Green Tier, serves 8, 50 min total. This cheap baked oatmeal costs about 94 cents a serving and makes eight make ahead breakfasts. Oats, apple and peanut butter, full cost breakdown inside.

- [Cheap Chicken Leg and Rice Bake](https://fedforless.ca/recipes/cheap-chicken-and-rice-bake/): $2.44 per serving, Butter Tier, serves 6, 1 hr 5 min total. This cheap chicken leg and rice bake makes six filling servings for about $2.44 a serving. Drumsticks baked on the rice, full cost breakdown inside.

- [Cheap Freezer Burritos with Beans, Rice and Cheese](https://fedforless.ca/recipes/cheap-freezer-burritos/): $1.70 per serving, Butter Tier, serves 8, 50 min total. These cheap freezer burritos cost about $1.70 each and stock the freezer with eight big meals. Beans, rice, corn and cheese, full cost breakdown inside.

- [Cheap Lentil Soup with Potato and Carrot](https://fedforless.ca/recipes/cheap-lentil-soup/): $1.34 per serving, Green Tier, serves 6, 45 min total. This cheap lentil soup makes six filling bowls for about $1.34 a serving. Red lentils, potatoes and carrots, one pot, full cost breakdown inside.

- [Cheap Split Pea and Ham Soup](https://fedforless.ca/recipes/cheap-split-pea-soup/): $1.21 per serving, Green Tier, serves 8, 1 hr 20 min total. This cheap split pea and ham soup makes eight filling bowls for about $1.21 a serving. One pot, freezer friendly, full cost breakdown inside.

- [Cheap Unstuffed Cabbage Roll Skillet](https://fedforless.ca/recipes/unstuffed-cabbage-roll-skillet/): $2.31 per serving, Butter Tier, serves 6, 45 min total. This cheap unstuffed cabbage roll skillet makes six servings for about $2.31 each. Pork, cabbage, rice and tomato in one pan, full cost breakdown inside.

## Free tools

- [Cost Per Serving Calculator](https://fedforless.ca/tools/cost-per-serving-calculator/): add up a recipe's ingredient costs and divide by real servings.
- [Recipe Cost Calculator](https://fedforless.ca/tools/recipe-cost-calculator/): turn package prices into the cost of the amount a recipe actually uses.

## Contact

Email hello@fedforless.ca. The newsletter is free: subscribe on the homepage and new recipes arrive by email automatically.
